why: For an already-cancelled order with a failed or missing refund, CO-01 and failure row line 93 only say 'propose nothing' (CO-A4 is not a proposal), while CO-07 (line 80) literally fires on 'cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued'; the packet's 'changes nothing' (review-packet.md line 72) is not stated in the spec, and CO-S06 (refund issued) never tests it, so an agent or test could go either way.
